title: Mail network: decide each mail only once
goal: After the owner answers "is this a newsletter?" for a mail, the same question never comes back for that mail unless its content really changed.
summary: The Intake treats every Outlook metadata change (read, flag, category) as a new mail version, so an unchanged mail runs through the network again and reaches the same choice twice. The Decisions tab then shows only the newest version; answering it leaves the older question open, and it reappears hours later. Fix the Intake to version mails by content, and let one owner decision close all open questions of the same mail.

problem.statement: The owner classifies a mail as a newsletter and is later asked the same question for the same mail again.
problem.impact: Repeated work and lost trust in the inbox; the duplicates also double the items in the IdP approval batch.
problem.approach: Version mails by content in the Intake and let a decision close older open questions of the same mail.
problem.outcome: One question per mail; an answered mail does not reappear.

context: Revision 1 described the wrong problem (the second IdP approval after the choice); the owner corrected this on October 8, 2026. Revision 2 replaces it completely. Evidence comes from a consistent read-only copy of the installed Pods database (October 8, 08:07) for Delta Mind mail network b95f1f8a revision 3, gate `uncertain-review`: 58 questions for 52 mail cases. Six cases received a second question through case revision 2, created by the Intake about 15 minutes after revision 1; between the two revisions only the `evidence` field differs, which hashes the Outlook `changeKey`. Subject, sender, date and body are unchanged. In all five decided cases the owner first answered revision 2, and revision 1 came back and was answered again hours later (for example ATS Convention: 08:25 and 13:44 on October 7). The installed Intake script (hash 55fc78ba) and apps/openape-pods/examples/network-mail-intake.mjs both use `changeKey` as the version. In the engine, every event on a choose gate's input creates its own `network_choices` row (network-events.ts `deliver`), and `choose` decides only that event. Separately, ATS Convention exists twice in the mailbox as two provider items; such genuine duplicate deliveries are separate mails and outside this plan.
scope: Intake: version a mail by a fingerprint of its content (sender, recipients, subject, date, body, attachment flag) instead of the Outlook changeKey; existing checkpoint entries are carried over without emitting the sampled mails again.

Network engine: an owner decision at a choose gate also closes every older open question of the same case at that gate (recorded as superseded, not routed a second time); the Decisions tab then shows the case once and it does not return.
Rollout: update the installed Intake member through the existing member-script update (same contract, network keeps running) and install a signed desktop build for the engine change.
nonGoals: Changing the approval gate, the network composition or the mail categories.
Merging genuinely duplicate deliveries (two provider items with the same content) or similar-looking but different mails.
Automatically reapplying an earlier decision to a mail whose content really changed; that case is still asked.

decisions.title: The problem is the repeated choice, not the IdP approval
decisions.description: Owner correction of revision 1. The approval gate for newsletters stays as it is.
decisions.reference: Mein eigentliches Problem ist aber, dass ich das erste Mal bestätige, dass ein Mail ein Newsletter ist und danach mir noch einmal die Entscheidung vorgelegt wird, ob dieses E-Mail ein Newsletter ist.

decisions.title: The final IdP approval stays
decisions.description: The approval after the owner's choice is intended and remains; only the repeated choice for the same mail must go.
decisions.reference: Die finale Freigabe neben der Entscheidung ist ok. Die darf bleiben. Nur die doppelentscheidung nicht

decisions.title: Fix both the source and the decision surface
decisions.description: The Intake fix removes the meaningless revisions for mail. The engine fix ensures that any source with case revisions can no longer leave a hidden older question behind an answered one. Either alone leaves a known way to be asked twice.

milestones.title: Version mails by content in the Intake
milestones.goal: A read, flagged or recategorised mail produces no new revision.
steps: In examples/network-mail-intake.mjs compute the version as a prefixed fingerprint of the content fields; use it for the checkpoint comparison, the emit key, sourceVersion and the evidence record.
Treat a checkpoint entry with the old changeKey format and the same provider id as already seen and store the content version, so the update emits nothing for the six sampled mails.

Keep a bounded list of up to 400 digests of seen content versions in the checkpoint, so a mail that leaves the three-message sample and returns is not emitted again (its knownContact flag can differ, which the network refuses for an existing source identity).
After approval, apply the same change to the installed Intake member through networks updateMemberScript and verify the next Intake runs.
acceptance: Focused test in the existing Intake suite: a changeKey-only change emits nothing; a changed body emits one new version; a legacy checkpoint emits nothing.
On the installed network, a read mail produces no case revision 2 over the following Intake runs.
milestones.proof: Commits 11b6c4a1 and 65edc55d with focused tests that fail against the previous script. Installed Intake updated through networks updateMemberScript on October 8: 08:38:58 (5d3613d5, definition version 4) and, after review, 08:46:39 (30c13820, definition version 5).
milestones.rollback: Reactivate the previous Intake script version through the same member-script update.

milestones.title: One decision closes all open questions of a case
milestones.goal: An answered case cannot come back from an older revision.
steps: In the choose transaction remove older undecided questions of the same case and gate and record them as choice-superseded in the trace (the schema allows a decided row only with its own routed result); they are never routed. A stale surface repeating the same answer is accepted without effect.
Counts, the settlement check and the Decisions tab treat superseded questions as resolved.
acceptance: Engine test: two revisions waiting, answering the newer routes once and leaves no open question; answering an older revision leaves a newer one, whose input differs, open; a revision arriving after the decision is still asked.

Pods unit/component suite, root lint and typecheck pass; signed desktop build installed with profile backup; the currently waiting double question (Imunify, case 7ce6bc47) disappears after one answer.
milestones.rollback: Reinstall the previous signed desktop build; it reads the same schema.

risks.title: A content change is missed
risks.mitigation: The fingerprint covers every field the Intake passes on; a mail whose passed-on content is unchanged carries no new information for later steps.

risks.title: A superseded question disappears from the choice table
risks.mitigation: No schema change; the input event and a choice-superseded trace entry remain; settlement and counts are covered by tests.

verification: Plan authoring only: the evidence above comes from read-only queries on a database copy and from the code; no product change is claimed in this draft.
handoff: M1 is live on the installed mail network; its acceptance waits for the next Intake runs. M2 is implemented on PR 307 (head 65edc55d; Pods 1,343 tests, root lint and typecheck pass) and needs merge plus a signed desktop installation.

changelog.text: Revision 1 proposed skipping the IdP approval for owner-chosen newsletters.
Revision 2 after the owner's correction: the problem is the repeated choice; root causes traced in the installed database and code.
Recorded the owner's confirmation that the final IdP approval stays; scope unchanged.

Revision 3 after implementation review: a decision closes only older revisions (newer revisions and sibling items keep their own question), superseded questions are removed with a trace entry instead of a schema change, and the Intake remembers seen content versions. Owner approval applies to revision 2; revision 3 narrows M2 within its stated non-goal.

approval.scope: Plan revision 2 including the live Intake update after M1.

entries.text: Die Intake wertet jede Outlook-Metadatenänderung (gelesen, markiert, Kategorie) als neue Mail-Version. Eine unveränderte Mail läuft dadurch erneut durchs Netz und landet ein zweites Mal bei derselben Frage. Der Tab Entscheidungen zeigt dann nur die neueste Version; deren Beantwortung lässt die ältere Frage offen, die Stunden später wieder auftaucht. Lösung: Die Intake versioniert Mails nach Inhalt, und eine Owner-Entscheidung schließt alle offenen Fragen derselben Mail.

Evidence comes from a consistent read-only copy of the installed Pods database (October 8, 08:07) for Delta Mind mail network b95f1f8a revision 3, gate `uncertain-review`: 58 questions for 52 mail cases. Six cases received a second question through case revision 2, created by the Intake about 15 minutes after revision 1; between the two revisions only the `evidence` field differs, which hashes the Outlook `changeKey`. entries.text: Revision 1 beschrieb das falsche Problem (die zweite IdP-Freigabe nach der Auswahl); der Owner hat das am 8. Oktober 2026 korrigiert. Revision 2 ersetzt sie vollständig. Grundlage ist eine konsistente, lesende Kopie der installierten Pods-Datenbank (8. Oktober, 08:07) für das Delta-Mind-Mail-Netz b95f1f8a Revision 3, Gate `uncertain-review`: 58 Fragen zu 52 Mail-Fällen. Sechs Fälle bekamen eine zweite Frage über Fall-Revision 2, die die Intake etwa 15 Minuten nach Revision 1 erzeugt hat; zwischen beiden Revisionen unterscheidet sich nur das Feld `evidence`, das den Outlook-`changeKey` einschließt. Betreff, Absender, Datum und Inhalt sind gleich. In allen fünf entschiedenen Fällen hat der Owner zuerst Revision 2 beantwortet; Revision 1 kam Stunden später wieder und wurde erneut beantwortet (z. B. ATS Convention: 08:25 und 13:44 am 7. Oktober). Das installierte Intake-Skript (Hash 55fc78ba) und apps/openape-pods/examples/network-mail-intake.mjs verwenden beide `changeKey` als Version. In der Engine legt jedes Ereignis am Eingang eines Choose-Gates eine eigene Zeile in `network_choices` an (network-events.ts `deliver`), und `choose` entscheidet nur dieses Ereignis. Davon getrennt liegt ATS Convention zweimal als zwei Provider-Einträge im Postfach; solche echten Doppelzustellungen sind eigene Mails und nicht Teil dieses Plans.
